definitions.explanation: The state of being mentally prepared for something, including having the right attitude and expectations.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}に{臨|のぞ}む{心構|こころがま}えができた。
examples.english: I'm mentally prepared to face the exam.

examples.japanese: {社会人|しゃかいじん}としての{心構|こころがま}えを{教|おし}える。
examples.english: I'll teach you the mindset of being a working adult.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}があっても{動|どう}じない{心構|こころがま}えが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: You need the mental preparedness to stay calm no matter what happens.

notes:
FORMATION:
{心|こころ} (heart/mind) + {構|かま}え (stance, from {構|かま}える to prepare)

Literally 'heart/mind stance.'

COLLOCATIONS:
・{心構|こころがま}えができる - to be mentally prepared
・{心構|こころがま}えを{持|も}つ - to have a mindset
・{心構|こころがま}えとして - as a mental attitude
・しっかりした{心構|こころがま}え - solid mental preparedness

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{覚悟|かくご} - resolve, determination (stronger)
・{心得|こころえ} - knowledge, understanding
・{気持|きも}ちの{準備|じゅんび} - emotional preparation
